items.evidence: Top line growth continues to be a key Company strategy, reflecting market development, market penetration, and market share performance
Earnings both from operating efficiency and financial management is a key driver of returns to shareholders
Cash flow generated from operations plus management of short-term receivables, inventory, and payables is a key driver of the Company's ability to re-invest
We endeavor to maintain high quality system compliance measured through FDA inspection results
Uses a cumulative compound annual growth rate (Cumulative CAGR) over # fiscal years, which is a more rigorous measure of sustained revenue growth.
ROIC measures all components of management's responsibility to generate sustained, long-term returns on invested capital.
Vesting is dependent on achieving a #-year diluted earnings per share cumulative compound annual growth threshold
